sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5-Coder is the latest series of Code-Specific Qwen large language models (formerly known as CodeQwen). As of now, Qwen2.5-Coder has covered six mainstream model sizes, 0.5, 1.5, 3, 7, 14, 32 billion parameters, to meet the needs of different developers.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct-GGUF: Text-to-Text model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: A: Yes. Qwen regularly releases updates, improvements, and new model sizes in the Qwen2.5-Coder family (currently covering 0.5B to 32B parameters). The Apache 2.0 license and active documentation indicate ongoing support, though support directly for the GGUF version depends on the community llama.cpp maintainers as well as Qwen.
